calibration_boundary.motivation: The matched 12-action control produced three 0/13 outcomes and every one of its twelve evaluated trajectories exhausted exactly 12 actions without an explicit completion marker.
calibration_boundary.changed_variable: Increase only the per-worker MiniSWE action budget from 12 to 20.
calibration_boundary.held_fixed: Model, endpoint, task, checkpoint, worker count, no-transfer mode, temperature, benchmark isolation, dependencies, evaluator, Core total, and test hash.
calibration_boundary.claim_scope: This is an action-budget calibration, not a treatment-effect run.

benchmark_isolation.checkpoint_dependency_materialization: Public requirements through checkpoint 2 are installed in inference and clean evaluation.

validity_gates.target_consistency: Every result uses Core total 13 and the frozen current test hash.
validity_gates.model_query_integrity: No API, quota, or rate-limit failure.
validity_gates.integrity: No infrastructure failure or prohibited benchmark-path access.

decision_rule.pass: Mean Core is at least 0.70, at least two of three workers score 10/13 or higher, and no worker scores 0/13 while still censored at the 20-action boundary.
decision_rule.conditional: If performance passes but every worker still reaches the exact 20-action boundary, permit one final 28-action calibration before treatment.
decision_rule.reject: Reject xjq CP2 for the main contrast if mean Core is below 0.70, fewer than two workers reach 10/13, or a zero-core boundary failure remains.
decision_rule.next_if_pass: Amend the untouched main two-arm config to the calibrated action budget, then rerun it from a fresh directory.
